動画の全体。色の付いた所がレース(選んでいるレースは明るく)、灰色がレースの外。.en: The whole video. Coloured parts are races (the selected race is brighter), grey is outside races. White marks are where ◀ Prev / Next ▶ stop, the yellow line is now. Click or drag to go there

サスペンションの縮みから、荷重が前後・左右のどちらへ移ったかを 1 つの点で見る.en: A plot showing, as one point, which way the load has moved front/rear and left/right, from suspension compression. Shown in the same place as the course map

荷重移動。サスペンションの縮みの差で、点は沈んでいる側へ寄る(ブレーキで上 =.en: Load transfer, from the difference in suspension compression. The dot moves toward the side that is compressed (up to the front tyres under braking, left to the outside left tyres in a right-hand corner). Horizontal = right pair − left pair, vertical = front pair − rear pair (% of full travel). Zero is set from driving straight at a steady speed. It moves later than G, so you can see how the brake is released and how the car pitches and rolls. A guide, not the actual load on each tyre (springs and bumps also change it). The circle is the top 2% of the difference reached on that surface in the selected race. The dot turns orange when slip exceeds the limit (1). The four bars around the circle are the suspension of each wheel, laid out like the tyres (they get shorter as the wheel is compressed; white line = driving straight at a steady speed, red = nearly lifting, orange = nearly fully compressed)

4 輪のサスペンションの縮み(0 = 伸び切り、100 = 縮み切り)。前の左.en: Suspension travel of each wheel (0 = fully extended, 100 = fully compressed). Front left / right, rear left / right

サスペンションの縮みの差(縮みきるまでの長さに対する %。まっすぐ一定の速さのと.en: Difference in suspension compression (% of full travel; zero when driving straight at a steady speed). Front/rear: + = front compressed. Left/right: + = right compressed

大きさはグラフの横のときだけ使う。0 ならグラフの高さに合わせた正方形(画面に見.en: The size is used only next to the graphs. 0 means a square as tall as the graphs (up to the visible height and 35% of the width). When next to the graphs, you can also drag the course map's bottom-left corner (anchored at the right edge and the top of the graphs).

ウィンドウの大きさと位置(最大化も)を覚えて、次に起動したときに戻す.en: Remember the window size and position (including maximized) and restore them next time

レース以外の発進(信号待ちなど)も印にし、「◀ 前 / 次 ▶」で止まる.en: Also mark launches outside races (e.g. at traffic lights) and stop at them with "◀ Prev / Next ▶"

ffmpeg は HEISO に入っていません。入れ方は docs/instal.en: ffmpeg is not included with HEISO. See "Exporting at 720p (ffmpeg)" in docs/install.md. With a GPU encoder (NVIDIA, AMD, Intel) it's fast; otherwise the CPU is used (slow). "Auto" picks what works on this PC in the order NVIDIA → AMD → Intel → CPU.

前後の加速度(縦)と横の加速度(横)を 1 つの点で見る図(摩擦円)。コース図と.en: A plot of longitudinal acceleration (vertical) against lateral acceleration (horizontal) as one point (the friction circle). Shown in the same place as the course map

摩擦円。横軸 = 横 G(右が正)、縦軸 = 前後 G(上 = 加速、下 = ブ.en: Friction circle. Horizontal = lateral G (right is positive), vertical = longitudinal G (up = accelerating, down = braking). The dot shows the direction the car is being pushed (opposite to the way your body is thrown: right in a right-hand corner, down under braking). The circle is the top 2% of the acceleration reached on that surface in the selected race (not the car's true limit). The dot turns orange when slip exceeds the limit (1). Big jumps outside the circle come from forces other than the tires, such as walls and landings.

今の点の後ろに、直近の何秒かの動きを残す.en: Keep the last few seconds of movement behind the current point

点を、前後何秒の平均でならすか(荷重移動と摩擦円で同じ)。広いほど細かい揺れが消.en: How many seconds either side to average the dot over (shared by load transfer and the friction circle). Wider removes more of the small jitter, but short peaks come out lower. The front/rear and left/right load graphs and the friction circle % graph use the same width

選んでいるレースで出た値の全部を、薄い点で重ねる(円の大きさの目安).en: Overlay every value in the selected race as faint dots (a guide to the circle size)

車体座標の加速度。前後は + = 加速、横は + = 右.en: Acceleration in the car's frame. Longitudinal: + = accelerating; lateral: + = right

映像で分かる瞬間(着地の衝撃、スタートの瞬間など)のコマと、グラフの同じ瞬間を指.en: Pick a frame with a clear moment in the video (a landing impact, the start, etc.) and the same moment on the graph, then save.

距離は 1 つのレースについて。レースが「全体」なら 1 レース目を選ぶ。リワイ.en: Distance is per race; with "All", the first race is selected. Runs redone by rewinds are left out, and the run that remained is laid out by distance

押すたびに ON / OFF。ON なら再生中、やり直し区間(リワインド・チェッ.en: Toggles ON / OFF. When ON, playback skips redo sections (rewinds, missed checkpoints) and pauses for photo mode or menus (gray bands in the graphs). Only while this recording is open (starts from the setting)

選んでいるレースを、配布パッケージ(.heiso.zip。動画・テレメトリー・情.en: Export the selected race as a package (.heiso.zip: video, telemetry and info in one file). The video runs from 5 s before to 5 s after the race

印・再生・グラフの段・同期の方式。どの記録にも共通.en: Marks, playback, graph rows and sync method. Shared by all recordings

空なら自動で探す(PATH、HEISO のフォルダの中の ffmpeg フォルダ.en: Leave empty to search automatically (PATH, the ffmpeg folder in the HEISO folder)

4 輪の路面が同じ所はその路面の色、違う所は紫で塗る.en: Color by surface where all 4 wheels agree, purple where they differ

車の後ろ上方から(進む向きに合わせて回る).en: From above and behind the car (turns with the heading)

コース図の範囲。全体以外は今の位置を真ん中にして追従する(一辺の長さ).en: Course map range. Except for All, it follows the current position at the center (length of one side)

リワインド・チェックポイント逃しでやり直した走りと、フォトモード・メニューの一時.en: Runs redone by rewinds or missed checkpoints, and pauses for photo mode or menus (gray bands in the graphs). Skip jumps over them

自動は、Windows の地域が米国か英国ならマイル(mph・ft・mi)、それ.en: Auto uses miles (mph, ft, mi) when the Windows region is the United States or the United Kingdom, and metric (km/h, m, km) otherwise. Only the display changes; the recorded data stays the same. The distance unit is also used for the X axis, the course map scale and range, and turn radius; the elevation unit is also used for jump drops.
